title: Alex is a great guide for English speaking people. Even better for English listening people.
text: Our guide Alex and the driver took us through the Costa bravo and the medieval village, and we had a wonderful time with great food for lunch and great company with the other guests who all seem to enjoy the tour also.
author: kcdenning2018

title: Excellent trip
text: Very nice trip, very pleasant group; excellent guide, explained clearly and knew the history well. Very nice too.
author: M9484JRantoniol

title: Costa brava
text: Rebecca was very attentive and informative on this tour. Made sure to not leave anyone out and let us hear an awesome history lesson over Spain. David was also an awesome driver, he seemed to share a liking into game of thrones and offered me some pretty cool insight on about what they offer with some of the scenes from the show tours. As a huge fan of GOT,  I was very intrigued. I’ve been on 3 tours with my time here in Spain so far and I must say, this one was my absolute favorite.
author: carlosaS4707VZ

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Experience with Alex!
text: Shoutout to Alex, our incredible tour guide today! 🌟 His knowledge of the local areas and his spot-on restaurant recommendation made the day unforgettable. If you're planning a trip, he's the one to look for. Will definitely be recommending him to everyone!
author: miguelfP8285UE
